```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="desk">

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Desk Top (link)   -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="top">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.685" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.154 0.63 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.685" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.154 0.63 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.685" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.045" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.045" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.0015"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Leg Links (4)     -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!-- Leg dimensions -->
  <xacro:property name="leg_width" value="0.05"/>
  <xacro:property name="leg_depth" value="0.05"/>
  <xacro:property name="leg_height" value="0.67"/>

  <!-- Helper macro for a leg -->
  <xacro:macro name="leg" params="name x y">
    <link name="${name}">
      <visual>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} ${leg_height/2}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="${leg_width} ${leg_depth} ${leg_height}"/>
        </geometry>
        <material name="metal">
          <color rgba="0.7 0.7 0.7 1"/>
        </material>
      </visual>
      <collision>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} ${leg_height/2}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="${leg_width} ${leg_depth} ${leg_height}"/>
        </geometry>
      </collision>
      <inertial>
        <mass value="2.0"/>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} ${leg_height/2}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <inertia ixx="0.0015" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
                 iyy="0.0015" iyz="0.0"
                 izz="0.0010"/>
      </inertial>
    </link>

    <joint name="${name}_joint" type="fixed">
      <parent link="top"/>
      <child link="${name}"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Positions of the four legs (relative to top centre) -->
  <xacro:leg name="leg_fl" x="-0.052" y="-0.285"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_fr" x=" 0.052" y="-0.285"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_bl" x="-0.052" y=" 0.285"/>
  <xacro:leg name="leg_br" x=" 0.052" y=" 0.285"/>

  <!-- ==================== -->
  <!--   Drawer (link)     -->
  <!-- ==================== -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.075" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.144 0.45 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_mat">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.8 0.8 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.075" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.144 0.45 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.075" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.018" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.010"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Prismatic joint for the drawer -->
  <joint name="drawer_joint" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="top"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <!-- Drawer closed position: its front face flush with the front edge of the desk -->
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit effort="30" velocity="0.1" lower="0.0" upper="0.2"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
